title: Barcelona defender faces new reality after losing his spot in the team for club and country
tweet:
Jules Koundé starting just twice for Barça so far this season — and sitting out consecutive games for France — marks a genuine shift in his status for club and country.

The Frenchman has admitted his level dropped last season, but at 27, this looks more like a tactical recalibration than the end of his path under Flick. Premier League interest will naturally build if the bench role continues, though as things stand, the immediate priority remains fighting his way back into the XI.
